name: Brain Extraction (FSL BET)
summary: Skull-strips a T1-weighted image with FSL BET, with optional robust centre estimation (-R) or bias-field and neck cleanup (-B), and outputs the brain-extracted T1w.
description: Runs FSL BET (via brain_extract.py inside brainlife/fsl:6.0.4-patched2) on a T1w volume. Lower frac gives a larger brain mask; use robust for unusual head shapes and bias_neck_cleanup for images with strong bias or a lot of neck. Use it when you need a brain-only T1w for registration or segmentation.

outputs.description: Brain-extracted T1w volume produced by FSL BET.

parameters.description: BET fractional intensity threshold (0–1). Lower values give a larger brain mask.
Use robust brain centre estimation (-R). Slower but more reliable for unusual head shapes.

failure_modes.fix: Check the BET log; the T1w input may be missing or unreadable.
